title.narrative: Operation of Al-Ja’dah Health Center in Hayran District, Hajjah Governorate

description.narrative: Operation of the health center Continue to limit the spread of diseases and epidemics and provide emergency health services

Saving life, maintaining its continuity, limiting the spread of diseases and epidemics, securing basic health and nutritional services, reproductive health, and supporting the health sector for some districts in Hajjah governorate and resettling them.

The full readiness of the health center to start providing integrated health care and nutritional services to 88,470 beneficiaries in integrated health care services, child and women health, therapeutic nutrition services, immunization services, reproductive health services, treatment of people with epidemics, prevention of epidemics, provision of bandage services, follow-up and reduction of complications of injuries And its infections / Providing radiological and laboratory services according to the need for the health condition / Preserving the environment and preventing the spread of epidemics by burning waste in the incinerator designated for that / Continuing the work of the health center with medical, technical and administrative staff to provide health services and the availability of medicines and laboratory solutions Continuing the work of devices and serving patients according to their health condition
